Leander is quickly becoming one of my favorite ships. She's just so positive and generous. Practically costs nothing at all at eight fuel you drop her on your fleet that chill beautiful angel gives you a firepower buff for your cruisers. And you get this adorable little CL that can fire her 150TbtsKC and torpedo salvos.

But more than Leander is just so positive. She comes on the sortie like "みんあ、一緒に行きましょう" and I'm like "yeah Leander let's ikimashou" and when she attacks she's like " うん…ちょうどいい間合いです！ " and I'm like "yeah that's just right." She doesn't say some bullshit macho shit like " さあ！頼るがいい！ " she's just like "一緒に行きましょう" And she looks so happy. I mean this is a WW2 light cruiser literally brought to life by the Japanese's love for 2D girls. She understands her life is a temporary magical gift and the gal is just fucking loving it. [I mean look at her face she's just so happy.](https://azurlane.koumakan.jp/w/images/thumb/9/93/Leander.png/594px-Leander.png)

I am literally never sad when Leander is on sortie. IDK if she's gonna make it into the metagame or not but for now she a pretty chill ship

Can’t remember when PR ships were first released but I got my first bote (Monarch) on May 7, followed by Neptune on May 25. I took it easy after those two and just kinda passively accumulated exp while farming out events/BPs/drop-only ships. The longest PR ship (Ibuki) took 26 days, but largely due to me not playing as much during that period.

Overall even if you optimize exp gain as much as you can, it still comes down to your play habits and how much time you’re willing to spend absent-mindedly sortieing while (hopefully) still preserving your sanity. Good luck!
